messages:
anya: heads up, PR #4472 preview shows 404s on some redirect targets and fonts after the infra team rotated the preview creds. preview: https://deploy-preview-4472--docs.redwood.com

kevin: can you grab the Vercel build output? last time this was a signed asset/credentials mismatch.

anya: pasted the relevant lines:
```
10:12:03 PM  INFO  fetching redirects from _redirects
10:12:04 PM  WARN  failed to fetch private asset: 401 unauthorized
10:12:04 PM  WARN  using fallback local redirect rules
10:12:05 PM  SUCCESS built site, published draft
```

ravi: 401 -> means the preview token our docs pipeline passes isn't accepted. infra rotated PREVIEW_SERVICE_KEY -> PREVIEW_DEPLOY_TOKEN last week and the docs workflow still uses the old var.

kevin: quick fix: update .github/workflows/docs-preview.yml to read $PREVIEW_DEPLOY_TOKEN. low risk. but we should avoid blocking all doc merges for a tiny env rename. suggestions: a) add a lightweight "preview-fast" job that just runs mkdocs build and publishes a draft page without asset fetch; b) add a PR label `do-not-merge-until-preview` that prevents merges if preview shows redirect/fetch warnings.

anya: i like (a). reviewers can iterate on content while infra finishes credential updates. i'll open the workflow PR for preview-fast.

callie: add a tiny PR checklist bullet: "verify redirects + fonts in preview or run local redirect serve". people forget fonts often. also add a note to the contributor guide about the two preview job types.

ravi: quick preview workflow snippet i was thinking of (reusable job):
```
jobs:
  preview-fast:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/preview-reusable.yml
    with:
      mode: fast
      publish: draft
```
it calls the reusable workflow that only runs mkdocs build + creates a draft preview URL, without syncing private assets.

kevin: perfect. and for anyone who needs to check redirects locally, paste these commands in the PR description:
```
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs build
# serve static site and redirects to simulate preview
python3 -m http.server 9001 --directory site
# or run mkdocs serve if you want hot reload
mkdocs serve --dev-addr=127.0.0.1:8000
```

anya: i'm also adding a short troubleshooting blurb: if draft preview shows 401/403 for fonts, try rerunning the preview after the infra secret is propagated or delete the preview's cached artifacts in Vercel (Project -> Deployments -> Clear cache).

docs-bot: Vercel deployment queued for PR #4472. Draft URL will be posted when build completes.

callie: can you also add a small automerge guard that checks for the `preview-clean: true` CI label before merge? prevents accidental fast-merges while redirects are broken.

ravi: yeah we can add a branch protection check using a small GitHub action that sets a `preview-clean` check from the CI pipeline only when full preview job passes.

kevin: timeline? i can review the workflow PR today. if it lands, we can re-run this PR's preview and unblock other docs merges.

anya: i'll open the workflow + PR template patch and tag kevin. holding merge until either full preview is green or the preview-clean check exists. will update this thread with links. :sparkles:
